solves.reasoning: a ___ tune=soft(부드러운 선율), something ___=brave(Naomi 격려), as she ___=focused. soft-brave-focused=ch[0].
seemed to have ___ from mind=faded(잊음), voice ___ at first=shaky, weight ___=lifted. faded-shaky-lifted=ch[3].
had ___ over and over=practiced, ___ breath=deep, as she ___ singing=continued. practiced-deep-continued=ch[1].
③foolish 부적절—Naomi는 무대에 서는 것이 brave(용감)라 격려. 원문 brave.
④grew 부적절—어깨의 무게는 lifted(사라짐)여야 함. grew(커짐)는 반대.
①noise 부적절—공연에서 흐른 것은 melody(선율). noise(소음)는 어색.
knew the ___ by heart=lyrics(가사). 노래 공연 맥락.
took a deep ___ and began to sing=breath(숨).
The ___ on her shoulders slowly lifted=weight(무게/부담).
awful=terrible(끔찍한). wonderful은 반대, quiet/loud 의미축 다름.
faded from mind=vanished(사라졌다). appeared/remained 반대.
each note rang out=sounded(소리났다). stopped/faded 반대, whispered는 작음.
shaky(떨리는)↔steady(안정). nervous는 유사어 함정.
brave(용감)↔cowardly(겁많은). kind/honest/calm는 다른 축.
(A) note rang out=음(음표), (B) short note on table=쪽지. ch[1]=음-쪽지.
regular repeated pattern of beats in music=rhythm(리듬).
seemed to have + p.p. → fade의 과거분사 faded.
took/began과 나란한 과거 서사 → find의 과거 found(불규칙).
knew the lyrics ___=by heart(외워서). 공연 전 암기 상태.
each note rang out ___=without hesitation(망설임 없이). 자신감 회복.
